A new leveling system is being introduced for mid-end game: Reawakening. Reincarnation levels have been changed to be limited to 100 total. Once you’ve reached 100, you can be Reawakened. Upon being awakened, you will lose all Reincarnation Points, Exp and Stats, Inventory and Gear, and coins. In exchange, you will receive a multiplier on all stats as if you’d maxed all Reincarnation tracks, as well as on all Exp and Coin gains. In addition, your stat cap will go up by 10, allowing you to achieve even more power, you will level up stats automatically when Rebirthing in Cave, and your inventory will no longer be lost on Rebirth.
